summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare a monthly distribution of $0.15 per share payable on July 30, 2026, to holders of record July 22, 2026, from taxable net investment income. The filing is a routine distribution announcement, not a special situation. No merger, acquisition, activism, strategic review, tender, delisting, or restructuring is involved. The disclosure provides no deal terms, advisor, premium, or structural mechanics. This is an ordinary course event for a closed-end fund. There is no risk-arb angle or special-situation catalyst.
